name: 泥潭II
english_description: A sibling build in the same ES2/Annihilator-engine family as nte (Mire 2), sharing several core infrastructure files byte-for-byte with it — the login, naming, and version-sync daemons — while the roughly 10,000 remaining files of actual game content were developed independently. Like nte, it gates full 'born' status behind a creation-myth NPC dialogue ritual rather than a simple registration step.
